📖 How this report works

What it shows

How well vendors deliver: every receipt line on their purchase orders, with when it was scheduled and when it came in, and how much was ordered and received. It is the BI version of the standard Vendor Performance Report and reads the same data the same way.

Late, rejected, waiting

A line is late when it was received on a later day than the PO line was scheduled; the received date shows in amber. Rejected and Entered (not received yet) lines show their status in red; an entered line's qty is the qty still expected, in grey.

A † on Qty Ordered marks a line that was closed short: Fishbowl sets its ordered qty to what was received, so the original order isn't known.

The dates apply to Date Scheduled (the default) or Date Received; the range starts on This month.

Using it
  • Filter changes apply straight away. Choosing no vendors or location groups means all of them.
  • More columns adds the days late, the part's description, the PO line number, the line's status and the PO's location group.
  • Click a vendor's row to show or hide its lines; Expand / Collapse do every vendor. Click a vendor, PO or part to open it in Fishbowl.
  • Opened from the Vendor module, the report starts on that vendor; change the Vendors filter to see others.
  • Click a column heading to sort the lines within each PO (again to reverse, a third time for the standard order). Drag a heading onto another to move the column; drag a heading's right edge to resize it. Your layout is remembered; Settings → Reset column layout undoes it.
  • Scorecard (the view selector) puts one row per vendor: POs, receipt lines, received, on time, late, the on-time %, the average and the most days late, rejected and still to receive. Click a heading to rank the vendors.
  • Pivot shows the on-time % (or days late, received or late lines, qty received, the number of lines or POs) by any two of vendor, PO, part, status, outcome, location group, line status, date scheduled and date received. It opens on the on-time % by vendor and month scheduled. Click a figure to see the lines behind it. Print, PDF and Excel follow the view on screen.
  • The App / PDF buttons in the header switch between this interactive view and the printable pages, laid out like the standard report. In PDF view pick the paper size and orientation in the bar above the pages; they are remembered. Print prints those pages.
  • A very large result shows its first 10,000 or so lines (whole vendors) with a Load all button; the figures then cover the lines shown.
